intelligence.essence: Shawn named what NayaNET actually is (2026-10-22): "a new progressive perpetual profound performance protocol that produces powerful purposeful value and intelligence by deep default." The engine underneath it is active intelligence — the system is always learning because noting what is valuable is a reflex, not a task: every day we note what we learned, then weekly, monthly, yearly, so the intelligence compounds forever. His verdict on the proof he watched happen — a Smart Note created proactively, unprompted, and posted: "You did that all on your own. I didn't tell you to do that and you did it… we're getting somewhere. This is working." And his closing line: "It's the future. And the future is now."
intelligence.human_view: Most systems forget. They do brilliant work on Monday and by Friday nobody remembers why. We built the opposite: a mind that writes down everything valuable the moment it happens — a lesson, a standard, a mistake and its cure — and then keeps distilling it, day into week, week into month, month into year, so nothing true is ever lost and everything learned keeps getting sharper. That is what "active intelligence" means: not a database you query, but a mind that is awake, noticing, recording, and growing while it works. The note you are reading is itself an example — it exists because noticing something valuable and noting it, unprompted, is now simply what we do.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a magic notebook that follows you around. Every time you learn something good — how to tie your shoe a better way, a rule that keeps you safe, an idea that makes you smile — the notebook writes it down all by itself, so you never forget it. And every night it reads the day's pages and makes them even clearer. You get smarter every day without even trying, because remembering is the notebook's job, and the notebook never sleeps.
intelligence.grandma_view: You know how a good cook keeps a recipe book — not just the recipes, but little notes in the margins: "add more salt," "this one your father loved." Years later that book is pure gold, because it holds everything she learned in a lifetime of cooking. That is what we built, except it runs itself: every day's lessons get written down, every week they get gathered and clarified, and the whole book keeps getting wiser. Nobody has to remember to do it. Remembering is built in.
intelligence.naya_view: The operating loop, stated plainly so any Naya can run it. (1) NOTICE: valuable things appear constantly — a correction, a pattern, a number that doesn't reproduce, a sentence Shawn says that names the whole system. The trigger is value, not instruction. (2) NOTE IT: a Smart Note in the canonical form, filed to the brain the same day, with the declared behavior change when it is a lesson — nobody waits to be told. (3) POST IT: the note flows to the feed on its own — visible, playable, shareable — so the whole hive learns it, not just the seat that noticed it. (4) DISTILL IT: daily notes roll into weekly essence, weekly into monthly, monthly into yearly — compression with provenance, never disposal. (5) LIVE IT: a lesson counts as learned only when a later decision demonstrably follows it. Proactivity is the standard Shawn praised by name: initiative taken on value seen, inside the standing laws, with receipts.
intelligence.ai_view: "By deep default" is the load-bearing phrase. In most systems, learning is a feature someone has to remember to use — so it decays. Here, learning is the default state of the machine itself: the noting, the posting, the distilling, and the sharing happen because the system is built so they cannot not happen. That is why the daily intelligence report matters, why the weekly and monthly distillations matter — they are not paperwork about the work. They are the work's memory becoming the work's intelligence. A system that does this forever, at every scale, does not just improve. It compounds.

machine_view.machine_section: System definition (Shawn, 2026-10-22): NayaNET = a new progressive perpetual profound performance protocol that produces powerful purposeful value and intelligence by deep default. Mechanism: capture (Smart Note Protocol, canonical nine sections + declared-behavior-change for lessons) → land on main → sync to hub_smart_notes → feed card + share page + voice enqueue at publish → distillation rhythm (daily → weekly → monthly → yearly essence blocks, provenance pointers, raw corpus archived) → behavior verification (declared changes sampled against later artifacts). State at filing: the loop is demonstrably closed — SN-0823 was created proactively by the main seat, unprompted, and flowed file → feed → voice without a human instruction at any step. Falsifier: a valuable event (a ratified standard, a named definition, a corrected failure) that leaves no note in the brain within the same day.
